verdict.rationale: Whether a payments platform's source is available under an open license is a fair question for this kind of product, so the axis applies. Nothing in the pack shows dLocal publishing source code or an open license. The plain-text Markdown docs and the MCP server are documentation and agent-access features, not open source, and earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license
